stack: react18 + esbuild, plain CSS custom-property tokens, static index.html

bad_guidance.why: Prescribes a faceted filter row with chips, popovers and a mobile sheet for a two-option segmented radio control; the record's own avoid_when ('one or two filters') applies; following it would be a redesign under a low change budget.
Search debounce, result counts and a TV search screen for a page with no search; selected because requirements mapped 'filters' to the search component.

misses.what: 'filters' mapped to components=[search] and primary_jobs 'accessibility search' on a page with no search; seeded comp-filters and search-filter-feedback.
process.safe_modification not demanded for a low-budget modify task on an existing UI although the base carries it.
No ontology id or record for skip links / bypass blocks / reach distance to a control (WCAG 2.4.1), which is the actual fix for 'can't get to'.
Focus slot marked new with 'no repository evidence' although a global :focus-visible ring token exists; design_context has no focus slot so inspect's focus_handling finding is not consumed.
Typography UNKNOWN despite --font-ui declared; spacing 'irregular'/UNKNOWN despite an explicit --sp-1..--sp-12 scale; radius evidence cites a 4px value not present in the CSS.

knowledge_gaps: skip link / bypass blocks (WCAG 2.4.1): reaching a control past repeated header chrome with few keystrokes

regressions.query: Keyboard users can't get to the chart filters.
regressions.expect: web/react project: components must not include search; comp-filters and search-filter-feedback must not be selected for a project whose only filter is a <=2-option segmented control; a11y-keyboard-operable and a focus-visible/non-text-contrast guardrail required.

regressions.query: Keyboard users have to tab through the whole header before reaching the page
regressions.expect: a bypass-blocks / skip-link record once it exists; meanwhile keyboard-operable and focus records, not desktop-shortcut or mobile-IME records.

regressions.query: inspect + direction on a project with a global :focus-visible ring token
regressions.expect: direction focus slot status preserved (repository evidence), not new.

regressions.query: inspect on a project declaring --font-ui and --sp-* custom properties
regressions.expect: typography KNOWN with the family list; spacing KNOWN with the scale.
